controlled_effects_cases.name: late_startup_admission
assertions: new service requires at least frozen 905s health bound plus 150s cleanup reserve
insufficient work window produces failed_harness before Popen

controlled_effects_cases.name: generation_client_timeout
assertions: actual retained invoke_replay helper passes client subprocess timeout=min(1800,1500,work_remaining)
phase expiry is failed_harness and later services do not start

controlled_effects_cases.name: final_owned_cleanup
assertions: owned cleanup starts with 150s reserve and completes at absolute_end=5400

controlled_effects_cases.name: b2_configuration_gate
assertions: B1/B2 normalized strict_args runs before first product comparison
B2 configuration drift is failed_harness and B3 does not start

scope: CPU controlled-effects validation only; no GPU, HTTP, production, compile, or push.
